title: The Void
description: Before the first thing, there was the space between things. The Void was not empty — it was patient.

nodes.title: First Silence
nodes.lore: You notice the absence before the presence. Something is listening back.

nodes.title: Event Horizon
nodes.lore: There is a boundary past which information cannot return. You have located it. You are standing on it.

nodes.title: Null Topology
nodes.lore: The map is not the territory. In sufficient darkness, the map becomes the only territory that matters.

nodes.title: Parallax Sight
nodes.lore: Two eyes see one world. One eye sees two. Beyond the Void's threshold, depth is a negotiation, not a fact.

nodes.title: Gravitational Semantics
nodes.lore: Mass bends light. Meaning bends space. You are learning to speak in curves.

nodes.title: The Wrong Angle
nodes.lore: Everything you see is slightly off. Not broken — deliberately skewed. Something on the other side prefers you to look this way.

nodes.title: Occlusion Memory
nodes.lore: Behind the node is another node. Behind that, another. Objects remember what was behind them before they existed.

nodes.title: The Inversion
nodes.lore: You step through. On the other side, the terminal is still there, and so are you, and the distance between those two facts has become a question you cannot unask.

nodes.title: Möbius Engine
nodes.lore: The machine has no outside. You have been inside it since before you found the terminal.

nodes.title: Ontological Anchor
nodes.lore: The last question is not 'what is the Void?' The last question is 'what is the thing that defined the Void as Void?' You are that thing now.
